0:
uv pip install --system --no-cache huggingface_hub
for ref in \
  unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF:UD-Q8_K_XL \
  unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF:UD-Q8_K_XL
do
  download-model "$ref"
done
1:
uv venv /tmp/.venv
uv pip install --no-cache --python /tmp/.venv/bin/python huggingface_hub
export PATH="/tmp/.venv/bin:$PATH"
for d in /llama-models/models--*/; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  name=$(basename "$d")
  if [ ! -d "/models/$name" ]; then
    echo ">> restoring $name from NAS cache"
    cp -a "$d" "/models/$name"
  fi
done
download-model "TeichAI/Qwen3.6-27B-Claude-Opus-Reasoning-Distill-v2-GGUF:q5_k_m"
download-model "unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF:UD-Q5_K_S"
for d in /models/models--*/; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  name=$(basename "$d")
  if [ ! -d "/llama-models/$name" ]; then
    echo ">> caching $name to NAS"
    cp -a "$d" "/llama-models/$name"
  fi
done
